title: Big D Randy
description:
🎃 BIG D RANDYRun. Hide. Laugh. Survive the legend of Randy! 👀Step into the dark and twisted world of Halloween, where you play as Lil Bro — a candy-hungry troublemaker exploring a creepy, nightmarish map in search of sweets. 🍬

But beware... in the shadows roams BIG D RANDY — a massive, unstoppable monster with terrifying speed and strength.
If he spots you, don’t think… run. Because Randy never misses his prey. 💀

This game blends horror and comedy, creating the perfect mix of funny chaos and pure panic. Test your nerves, outsmart Randy, and see if you can survive his world.

🕹️ GAME MODES• 🔥 Escape Mode – fully playable, intense, and terrifying!

• 📖 Story Mode – uncover the twisted origin of Randy himself...

• 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer – challenge your friends or get hunted together!

⚙️ FEATURES• Optimized visuals & smooth performance

• AI that hunts, learns, and scares for real

• Unique Halloween vibe 🎃

• Created in Unreal Engine 5
